THE SCOUTING REPORT

Know your prospects

HT is height in feet and inches. LB is weight in pounds. Both use Bulbapedia’s standard Pokémon forms. For long-bodied Pokémon, Pokédex height may represent length.

EST 40 is our estimated 40-yard dash time in seconds. Lower is faster. These game estimates assume a standing start on turf, allow ordinary flight, hovering, or burrowing, and exclude teleportation and special boosts.

Base stats are the standard-form Pokémon battle values: HP, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed. Their total is the base-stat total. Base Speed is separate from the estimated 40-yard dash. These are not football positional grades. Abilities include possible standard and hidden abilities across generations; no single ability is equipped.

Sources: PokéAPI base stats & abilities · Bulbapedia heights · weights
